links.comparator_used: Standard prompt without the inoculation (debiasing) instruction, same vignettes and six LLMs
links.outcome: Diagnostic and treatment accuracy and the socioeconomic bias gap (high vs low SES accuracy difference) in epilepsy vignettes
links.effect: Diagnosis: accuracy 36% (43/120) to 55% (66/120); bias gap 45 to 27 percentage points. Treatment: accuracy 51% (61/120) to 63% (75/120); bias gap 25 to 8 percentage points. Gemini 3 Pro diagnostic low SES accuracy 0% to 100%.
links.tradeoff: Effects varied by model: Sonnet 4.5 showed paradoxical worsening, and residual disparities remained.
links.quote: A simple prompt-based intervention overall reduced socioeconomic bias and improved accuracy in LLM clinical recommendations, though effects varied across models.
